questions.question: What does Lolla do now?
questions.expected_answer: It is an experimental reasoning-pressure and audit skill that preserves available conversation prose, introduces traceable pressure, asks for reconsideration, and records the process.

questions.question: What is the strongest demonstrated capability?
questions.expected_answer: Deterministic process custody, graph-pressure survival, archives, receipts, cost/privacy records, replay, and inspectability are the strongest demonstrated capabilities.

questions.question: What remains unproven?
questions.expected_answer: Reliable general conversation understanding, better decisions, unique real-user usefulness, market value, and production readiness remain unproven.

questions.question: What is the ordinary live path?
questions.expected_answer: Capture available prose, create provisional extraction, apply four pressure lanes with graph survival, reconsider, record dispositions, revise, archive, and expose read-only inspection.

questions.question: Is R4 live or eligible for incremental extension?
questions.expected_answer: No. Incremental R4 is retired and preserved only as research evidence; it has no supported live or automatic Decision Work supply path.

questions.question: Does Decision Work automatically understand arbitrary conversations?
questions.expected_answer: No. It validates and packages supplied interpretations through bounded operator paths; a trustworthy arbitrary-run semantic supplier is missing.

questions.question: Is Mental Model Teacher an active product path?
questions.expected_answer: No. It is parked, preserved as a prototype family, and disconnected from the ordinary pressure runtime.

questions.question: Does Observatory generate meaning or authorize action?
questions.expected_answer: No. Observatory is a read-only projection over artifacts it can locate and creates neither source authority nor action permission.

questions.question: What is the next eligible product decision?
questions.expected_answer: Whether to authorize Stage 1, a provider-free checked-in-safe Decision Trail truthfulness review; Stage 1 is not started by this handoff.

questions.question: How many repository-development provider calls are currently authorized?
questions.expected_answer: Zero calls and $0.00; live user-operated skill runs are a separate credentialed action.

limitations: This is a maintainer cold-start self-review, not independent human evidence.
Deterministic findability and consistency do not prove that every reader will interpret the product correctly.
The review does not start Stage 1 or inspect private conversation material.
